text:
ryan: Quick heads-up — proposing a staggered pin for runtime v2.16 in the ap-southeast maintenance window (02:00-04:00 UTC). Not a full pin: only quantized-models group (quant-v2/*) and kernel-optimized variants. Want to avoid global stickiness.
jess: Are we pinning the SDK too or just runtime?
ryan: Just runtime for now. SDK 3.4.1 is already compatible per local smoke tests, but I'm leaving SDK unpinned to let client rollouts continue.
nina: +1 on slice pin. Can we scope by model tag (quant-v2) and runtime-kernel label so ops routing stays sane?
ryan: Yes — plan is to add entries to pinlist like: ````
- scope: region: ap-southeast
  target: runtime:v2.16
  models: [quant-v2*]
  reason: nightshift kernel regression mitigation
````
gary: :eyes: Are we aware of any customers relying on quant-v2 variants in that region overnight? Need to notify CS if we'll affect latency.
ryan: Contacted @support with a short blast. Low-traffic night window but want to be cautious.
deploy-bot: deploybot: Pin request queued: pinlist change 1882468101. Run `deploybot apply --pinlist changes/1882468101.patch` to apply. Status: queued -> awaiting-approval.
jess: Add canary route: apply to 10% of capacity first, hold 30m, then ramp to 100% if no regression.
ryan: Agreed. Canary config: ````
canary: 10%
hold: 30m
ramp: 1h
rollback-signal: error_rate>0.8% or p95>2000ms
````
nina: Ops checklist: preflight telemetry enabled, KV cache warmup disabled for canary instances, healthcheck threshold set to 95%.
ryan: I'll post the release note in #release-war-room after approval. Also adding a short rollback playbook:
- If p95 latency spikes > 2x baseline for 2 consecutive 5m windows -> trigger immediate unpin and route to fallback v2.14 pool.
- If error_rate > 0.8% -> abort and unpin.
jess: One more ask — tag the pinlist entry with `nightshift-staggered` so we can easily filter post-mortem telemetry.
ryan: Done. Patch updated with the tag.
deploy-bot: deploybot: Approval required from one of [ryan, jess, ops-lead]. Use `:thumbsup:` to approve.
gary: Approved. :+1:
ryan: Approved. Applying canary now.
deploy-bot: deploybot: Applying pinlist patch 1882468101 -> canary rollout started (10%). Logging to /var/log/deploybot/1882468101.log
jess: Watching telemetry. If no regressions by 02:40 UTC, ramp to 100%.
nina: Noted — will monitor KV cache misses and tail latency.
deploy-bot: deploybot: Canary hold completed. No regressions detected. Ramp scheduled.
ryan: Ramping to 100% now.
ryan: Post-ramp status: all systems nominal. Will leave pin in place for 12 hours then evaluate decay to automatic-unpin in 72h unless we see slow drift.
jess: Filing a short release note and tagging product.
ryan: Thanks all. If something odd pops up ping me directly.
